metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API Component Definition

components.title: Patient Intake Serverless API
components.description: Hardened API Gateway, VPC Lambda, KMS DynamoDB, and S3.

implemented-requirements.description: CMK KMS encryption enforced on S3 uploads (GAP-01) and DynamoDB intake table (GAP-02); validated by s3_encryption.rego and dynamodb_encryption.rego.
Lambda IAM role scoped to PutItem/GetItem and PutObject/GetObject (GAP-07); validated by iam_least_privilege.rego.
Lambda deployed in private VPC subnets with Gateway Endpoints and public S3 access blocked (GAP-05); validated by lambda_vpc.rego.
S3 bucket policy denies non-TLS requests via aws:SecureTransport=false (GAP-03).
CloudTrail, API Gateway access logs (GAP-08), and X-Ray active tracing enabled.
S3 versioning (GAP-04), DynamoDB PITR, SQS DLQ (GAP-06), and Object Lock GOVERNANCE Evidence Vault enabled; validated by s3_versioning.rego.
